summary: West kerb is a vegetated bank beside a narrow lane; nowhere to pull off.
reasons: Treed bank, no verge to pull onto
Cars park on opposite side only

best_section.where: West side of Jesmond Road just south of the roundabout

drivers.seclusion: Backs onto bush, but dwellings sit 14 m (near 4 m) and 12 m (near 52 m) from the kerb.
drivers.access_and_room: Narrow sealed lane; the west edge is a vegetated bank and power poles, so a van would sit in the lane.
drivers.traffic: Through road with a centre line and a roundabout just north.
drivers.convention: Cars park along the east side, not this side; no signs.

flags: Gate 20 m away has a mapped way round
Slope is flat at the best section but reaches 12% further south
sun_shade: Heavy canopy over the west verge; morning sun blocked, shaded most of the day.
cannot_judge: Exact verge width under the canopy
